show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: David Senra - Passion & Pain - [Invest Like the Best, Forever Episode]

reader_summary.headline: A few days ago, we had a discussion about what we call Forever episodes.
reader_summary.overview: A few days ago, we had a discussion about what we call Forever episodes. We went listening to old episodes to find the ones that qualified. And when I re-listened to this episode with David Senra, I left wildly energized and wanting to share that feeling.

key_points.text: A few days ago, we had a discussion about what we call Forever episodes.
key_points.evidence_quote: A few days ago, we had a discussion about what we call Forever episodes, which are the few episodes of our show that we think will be as popular a decade from now as they are today.

key_points.text: So we are re-releasing it today so that anyone that missed it the first time or hadn't yet discovered to invest like the best.
key_points.evidence_quote: So we are re-releasing it today so that anyone that missed it the first time or hadn't yet discovered to invest like the best, gets to hear it now.

key_points.text: Please share with your friends and loved ones as I think anyone will benefit from David's perspective and enthusiasm.
key_points.evidence_quote: Please share with your friends and loved ones as I think anyone will benefit from David's perspective and enthusiasm.

key_points.text: Have a great weekend and we'll be back with more next week.
key_points.evidence_quote: Have a great weekend and we'll be back with more next week.

thesis: The speaker describes how reading biographies functions as a mental movie that allows one to inhabit the intense pressures and life events of historical figures like Enzo Ferrari. He argues that understanding these deep personal struggles, such as losing a father and brother at a young age, explains the extreme work ethic and obsession displayed by founders like Ferrari.
